snippet.title: Eon of Life Trailer
snippet.description:
Eon of Life will be released this year on November 24th!

In this game, you guide the evolution of a creature for millions of years, changing its appearance, gaining new skills, and adapting to new environments.

You can add it to your wishlist on steam now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4106420/Eon_of_Life/
